query: I am a local government interested in climate change adaptation. What Horizon Europe opportunities exist for us?
response:
As an intelligent research assistant, I can confirm that local governments (Public Bodies) are highly prioritized organizations within Horizon Europe, particularly in areas related to societal challenges like climate change adaptation. You are fully eligible to coordinate and participate in relevant actions.

### Your Primary Funding Pathway: The EU Mission on Climate Adaptation

The most dedicated and relevant funding source for local and regional authorities focused on climate change adaptation is the **EU Mission: Adaptation to Climate Change**.

This Mission aims to support at least 150 European regions and local authorities in accelerating their climate resilience efforts by 2030, making it an ideal framework for local government involvement. Funding usually comes in the form of **Coordination and Support Actions (CSA)**, **Research and Innovation Actions (RIA)**, and **Innovation Actions (IA)**.

#### Relevant and Upcoming Call Opportunities (Focus: 2026)

The search identified specific opportunities under the Mission and related Clusters that align perfectly with local authority needs:

| # | Call ID | Title | Type | Focus | Deadline (Indicative) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **HORIZON-MISS-2026-01** | Support to regional and local authorities for climate adaptation planning and implementation | CSA | Provides concrete support to regions and local authorities to understand climate risks and design robust adaptation plans. Direct engagement with local communities is embedded. | March 31, 2026 |
| 2 | **HORIZON-CL5-2026-02-D4-03** | Innovative pathways for low carbon and climate resilient building stock and built environment (Built4People Partnership) | RIA/IA | Focuses on improved planning methods and procedures for decarbonisation and climate resilience of the built environment, highly relevant for municipal planning departments. | February 17, 2026 |

*(Note: These calls typically require international consortia involving research institutes and other partners.)*

### General Horizon Europe Eligibility for Local Government

Local government bodies and Public Bodies benefit from excellent eligibility conditions:

| Organisation Type | Eligible? | Funding Rate (RIA) | Funding Rate (IA) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Public Bodies** | Yes | 100% | 100% | Fully covered costs in all action types (RIA, IA, CSA) |

### Other Relevant Funding Clusters

Since climate adaptation is multidisciplinary, you should also look at the following Clusters:

1.  **Cluster 5: Climate, Energy & Mobility:** Topics focused on developing climate services, earth system observation, and integrating climate data into regional planning.
2.  **Cluster 6: Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture & Environment:** Topics covering the environmental impacts of climate change, such as water management, soil health, forest resilience, and biodiversity preservation (often requiring adaptation measures).

### Next Steps for Your Municipality

1.  **Focus on the Mission:** Review the full scope and expected outcomes of the **HORIZON-MISS-2026-01** call within the Mission Work Programme. This is tailored for regional/local government support.
2.  **Define Needs:** Identify which specific climate risks (e.g., flooding, heatwaves, drought) require innovative solutions or planning support in your municipality to define your project scope.
3.  **Build Consortium:** Start identifying partners (universities, specialized SMEs, other regions) from different EU/Associated Countries that have expertise in adaptation science, modelling, or urban planning.

***

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**

• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home) (where you submit proposals)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for the relevant Mission and Clusters
• Learn about EU Missions: [EU Missions Portal](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe/eu-missions-horizon-europe_en)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
